title: [human] Janitor needs post-merge smoke gate (union-corruption catcher)
description: From project-LICHEN-worker6-obgr: two concrete merge-union corruptions now in evidence (lichen/tests/schc_failure_tracker/CMakeLists.txt 48-line duplicate-block file on main; python/src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py __init__ tail spliced into now() dead code -> 12 red tests, fixed as yhbl). Systemic ask carried over from obgr: merge janitor should run a cheap post-merge smoke before landing — e.g. cmake configure of changed test dirs, py_compile of changed .py files, or at minimum flag files whose post-merge line count exceeds both parents. Fleet/janitor tooling decision; needs Mark's call on which gate(s) to wire.
